title: Adquire
description:
Problem it solves:
1. Airdrops are very expensive user acquisition strategies!
Uniswap: $350mn
JITO: $200mn

2. Rabithole, coinvise, etc are awesome tools but closed ecosystems

As an example, how will the hundreds of protocols being built at EthIndia hackathon will advertise their protocol to aquire the users?

Introducing Adquire - a highly composable Solidity library that any smart contract can use to advertise itself to every other protocol, dapp or users in crypto, with developer integrations under 3 minutes. 
With the use of Adquire, we can incentivize referrers based on real metrics of pay-per-action which is an onchain transaction.

Features -
1. Easy campaign management
2. Simple contract level integration
3. Peer-to-peer advertising with the use of Airstack and XMTP protocols

how_its_made:
1. We faced challenges with XMTP with Airstack specifically issues with messaging between two XMTP enabled users
2. We found some challenges with deploying to some different chains given the bridges are slow and challenges with the verification of contracts
3. Creating seamless frontend flow to demonstrate how dapps and users can publish ads, and get referral commision.
